title: The Cat Girl Slapstick Workday Crisis — Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: A sudden blast of dark sewage drenches the landlord right outside the doorway. The green-haired cat girl slips away before anyone catches her.
Panic strikes immediately as intense stomach spasms hit, sending her sprinting desperately for the nearest toilet.
Desperate for cash to fix her mess, she reports for heavy industrial labor, but the punishing jackhammer leaves her trembling and dazed.
Her day unravels when a strict matriarch corners her in the hallway to deliver a furious reprimand. Will she keep her job, or is she about to be thrown onto the street?

series.summary: The chaotic cat girl accidentally drenches her landlord in sludge and faces a disastrous day of grueling physical labor and confrontation.
